notes: T014 is gate preparation, not a gate: it builds the draft inventory that lets G4 tell a documented or provider host apart from one the sandboxed backend process requires. Sources were used in priority order and discovery was NOT needed for either backend: the pinned v3 claude workload kit declares a sandbox-scoped allow rule (its hosts are listed in the inventory), of which only api.anthropic.com carries task traffic, and the pinned v3 shell workload kit Codex runs on declares no network rule at all, so Codex's endpoints come from the pinned docker-agent artifact this project ships. No backend prompt was run, no credential was used and none was recorded. Nothing here is a proven allowance: G4 decides the effective per-sandbox policy, and every non-required Claude kit host is a must-deny candidate for it. Both sandboxes were mountless, created with --skills off, held no repository code, and were created and removed one at a time by name; sbx rm --all and sbx reset are never used, and nothing global changed.
